text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
I showed Daiichi Ruby a map to a certain location.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: And who is this?
choice_data_list: They say it's a hidden gem of a cafe for those in the know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I searched for a place where she could relax,
and found this shop tucked in a back alley that imports rare tea leaves, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe you have rested sufficiently.
choice_data_list: I-I wanted to learn more about black tea...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, to keep it brief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling a bit guilty for inviting her on a whim, I headed to the café hoping she'd like it, when—

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person A
text_block_list.text:
"Hold it right there!
Who gave you permission to walk down this street, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person B
text_block_list.text:
What's this? An outsider?
You ain't here to eavesdrop on our meeting, are ya?!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person A
text_block_list.text: Go on, spit out what business you got with me. That is, if ya ain't got anything to hide~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I turned down the wrong alley.
I've gotten cornered by some rather scary people...!
choice_data_list: We just took the wrong path, that's all...!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person A
text_block_list.text: "Where's your proof, huh?! Show me the proof! On what day and at what time did this happen, punk?!"

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person B
text_block_list.text:
Look look, the little one's watchin'.
You don't wanna look pathetic in front of 'em, right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now even Daiichi Ruby was getting dragged into it.
Just as I stepped in front of her,
trying to create some distance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Are you done talking?

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I was simply asking if that was all you wished to say.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's going on,
but we're in a hurry, so if you'll excuse us.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Make way.

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person B
text_block_list.text:
......O-Ooh...!
Not only is she not scared... she's standing tall and proud...?!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Person A
text_block_list.text: My apologies, Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is a black tea
not often distributed in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"It's simply not distributed outside this region of origin,
so it doesn't have any strange aftertaste and should be easy to drink."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the coffee shop, Daiichi Ruby begins explaining the black tea
as if nothing had happened.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's going on,
but we're in a hurry, so if you'll excuse us.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Make way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If trouble had broken out, it wouldn't have ended easily.
She stepped in to prevent that, helping us out—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?
choice_data_list: No, you're the one who helped me...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I am afraid I do not understand what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Our goal was to move forward,
so I simply stated it as such.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There is nothing out of the ordinary, I assure you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that she feels not a shred of fear
about getting cornered like that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I merely conveyed the requirements, nothing more.
Yet, faced with such a composed demeanor and sheer grit, I couldn't help but—
choice_data_list: I might get a little worried...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...What are you doing?
Please, raise your head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While thinking it unusual how she didn't flinch before an intimidating face, I felt I wanted to learn from her resolute demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Are you worried?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she's so fearless, I was about to say
she might plunge straight into danger...
but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Had it gone on any longer,
the mansion's staff would surely have
“persuaded” the other party.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, we have no desire to make a scene either.
I assure you it won't result in the kind of treatment you're imagining.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...From a distant seat, I can see the butler who secretly
followed us nodding along.
I truly caught a glimpse of the might of a powerful clan.
